headline: Driving Growth Through EVs and Electronics

highlights: EBITDA stood at INR 2,574 Mn, above our estimate of INR 2,131 Mn up by 44.67% YoY/ 21.62% QoQ.
On the margins front, EBITDA margin expanded by 17 bps YoY/ 29 bps QoQ to 11.76%, slightly below from our estimate of 11.84%.
PAT grew by 68.92% YoY/ -30.68% QoQ to INR 1,430 Mn above our estimate of INR 941 Mn.
PAT declined QoQ, largely reflecting a higher base in the previous quarter due to one-off gains.
valuation: Investment Rationale TFT Display Localization to Strengthen Electronics Business: The company secured multiple TFT instrument cluster orders ranging from 5-inch to 12-inch displays, with cumulative lifetime value exceeding INR 10,000 Mn and production scheduled from FY28 onwards.

Outlook and valuation: Minda Corporation's medium-term growth outlook is supported by three key drivers: increasing EV content, localization of electronics and expansion into system-level automotive products.
The company secured multiple orders during the quarter, with 60% of new business comes from new platforms and products, while 40% relates to replacement of existing platforms.
watch: EV Portfolio Emerging as a Key Growth Driver: EV products grew 113% YoY, contributing 10% of standalone revenue and 15% at the group level.

Outlook and valuation: Minda Corporation's medium-term growth outlook is supported by three key drivers: increasing EV content, localization of electronics and expansion into system-level automotive products.
